why_best: This approach captures the raw urgency of a live breaking exchange without obscuring the underlying footage or cluttering the frame with unnecessary network branding.
why_bad: A slow, elegant cross-fade of text blocks would erase the impression of real-time human interaction, making the sequence look like a static slide rather than a live event.
trap: A near-miss would wrongly apply the pre-arrival indicator to outgoing lines, destroying the authenticity of the interface.
